item.title: Run experiments with Murph in conversation
item.summary: The experiment website and public protocol library have retired. You can still plan and run a private experiment with Murph.
item.details: Ask Murph to set up a measured comparison, log sessions, review progress, or discuss results. Your saved experiments and their history remain available to Murph.

tryIt.label: Plan an experiment
tryIt.prompt: Help me plan a private experiment to test a change in my routine.
